warrants.quote: As of March 31, 2024, no pre-funded warrants were exercised and pre-funded warrants to purchase an aggregate of 9,689,293 shares of common stock outstanding.

Warrants to purchase 4,434 shares of the Company’s common stock at an exercise price of $140.25 per share which were previously issued by Tocagen, survived the Merger and remained outstanding as of March 31, 2024 and December 31, 2023.
